name: manhua-gongfang
description: Comic localization pipeline: batch download from MangaDex or comic web pages, multilingual OCR, AI translation with Chinese overlay, and PDF/CBZ composition.

displayDescription.en: Batch download comic images from comic web pages, smart compression, multilingual OCR, AI translation with Chinese overlay, and PDF/CBZ composition. Supports manual edit and resume.
displayDescription.zh: 漫画网页批量下载，智能压缩，多语言 OCR 与 AI 翻译，合成 PDF/CBZ，支持编辑续传。
